title: Review test · Unit 12 · The art of persuasion

fn.en: Show control of Unit 12 — and of the level. This is the bridge check to the next stage.

can.en: I can report what people said and asked, and argue both sides of a question.

items.q: “The advert is amusing.” → She said the advert ___ amusing.
“I saw an amazing ad.” → He said he ___ an amazing ad.
“I will never forget it.” → She said she ___ never forget it.
“Turn the light off.” → He asked his friend ___ the light off.
“Did you enjoy it?” → She asked ___ I had enjoyed it.
“What did you learn?” → He asked me what I ___.
“Can you give an example?” → He asked her ___ give an example.

items.from: She said: “I will never forget that advert.”
items.a: She said she would never forget that advert
alt: She said that she would never forget that advert

items.cue: Report it with WHETHER. Begin: She asked…
items.a: She asked whether I had enjoyed it
alt: She asked if I had enjoyed it

items.r: a very large advertisement beside a road
a reason somebody gives for not agreeing
gradually persuade them to agree with you
a disadvantage of an otherwise good idea
